notes.title: Square Heroes 1.6 Major Update
notes.notes:
Square Heroes 1.6 released in conjunction with the upcoming release of Square Heroes on PlayStation® 4

There are a raft of new features and fixes, so let's get right to it:

NEW FEATURES / CHANGES

 Cross-platform play with PlayStation® 4 (in addition to Windows, Linux and Mac)
 Added Japanese language
 Reduced XP required to level up to higher levels
 Allow Heroes to have the same name
 Added location to replay tutorial (near the professor) 
 Kingslayer mode now allows re-spawn if co-op friends still alive
 Link new Hero to Steam account even after first Create Hero dialog
 Added UPnP port mapping setting to fix connection issues for some


FIXED

 Suicide bug when hit an enemy’s projectile with melee
 Steam Achievements not awarded when language not English
 Steam overlay on Mac
 Deathmatch end level detection in net games when host is the last kill
 Reduced crate pick-up time to mitigate crate synch issues with high latency remotes.
 Various rare bugs
 Network error on Windows XP

notes.title: Patch release 1.5.3
notes.notes:
Another Square Heroes patch is now live. Issues addressed:

Bot spawn particles remain in level
Incorrect trophy and door state in single player
Alien spawn improvements in network games

May all your foes be short-lived!

notes.title: Version 1.5.2 patch release
notes.notes:
Another bug fixing release is now live. Issues resolved:

Game occasionally exiting when attempting to load level in single player.
Timer continues when an offline or single player game is paused.

Happy hunting!

- Gnomic

notes.title: Version 1.5.1 patch release
notes.notes:
Just uploaded builds for the full version and demo, with the following fixes:

Invisible players after join.
Password entry UI issues.
Intermittent crashes in network games.

Enjoy, and as always please leave us some feedback in the Community Hub!

- Gnomic
